sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Common But Differentiated Responsibilities (CBDR-RC)**: The cornerstone principle of the UNFCCC, acknowledging that all states must act but developed nations bear a greater historical burden. 
• **Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)**: Bottom-up climate action plans under the Paris Agreement, where countries define their own mitigation and adaptation targets. 
• **Climate Finance**: The flow of funds from developed to developing nations to support mitigation and adaptation, governed by the 'Polluter Pays' principle. 
• **Institutional Architecture**: The UNFCCC (Secretariat), COP (Decision-making body), and IPCC (Scientific assessment body) form the triad of global governance.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **NAPCC (India)**: National Action Plan on Climate Change comprising 8 national missions (e.g., Solar, Water, Sustainable Habitat). 
• **Panchamrit Strategy**: India's 5-point climate commitment announced at COP26, including Net Zero by 2070.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Lack of 'Loss and Damage' funding, technology transfer barriers, and geopolitical friction. 
• **Solutions**: Climate-resilient agriculture, circular economy, and decentralized renewable energy grids.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'P-A-N-C-H-A' (Panchamrit). 
• **Decoded Meaning**: P-500GW (Non-fossil), A-50% (Renewable energy), N-Net Zero (2070), C-Carbon Intensity (45%), H-Harmful Emissions (1 billion tonnes reduction).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses 'Kyoto Protocol' (legally binding targets) with 'Paris Agreement' (voluntary NDCs). Remember: Kyoto had Annex I/II; Paris applies to all.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Climate Justice' to argue for the rights of the Global South in international negotiations.

keyTakeaways: Governance is shifting from top-down (Kyoto) to bottom-up (Paris) approaches.
India's climate governance is anchored in the NAPCC and updated NDCs.
Climate finance remains the most contentious issue in global climate diplomacy.
